title: Warm Norwegian Fish Pilaf
description: A cultured and pillowy Norwegian dish featuring pitted black olives and fish, cooked in a papillote for a shojin-friendly meal
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
Cut the cod fillets into small pieces and season with salt and pepper
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and saute the fish until cooked through
In a large bowl, combine the cooked fish, Arborio rice, vegetable broth, lemon juice, and pitted black olives
Mix well and transfer the mixture to a large piece of parchment paper or aluminum foil
Fold the parchment paper or foil over the mixture to create a papillote and bake for 20 minutes
Remove the pilaf from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving
Serve the pilaf hot, garnished with additional black olives if desired
